player_prompt.intro:
Si Player {player_id} ta'u SimpleTak keessatti.
Baankii keessatti, stones kiinii '{player_stone}' jedhamuun argama, stones garuu duraan kiinii '{opponent_stone}' jedhamuun argama.

Dhufaan kee, cell biroo tokko (lakkoofsa isaa caalaa) ilaali, stones kiinii eegi.
Fknf, '[12]' stones kiinii cell 12 keessatti eegtii.

Murtii kee, path stones kiinii walitti dhufeen waliin baankii (dheerina-dheerinatti ykn aradda-araddatti) waliin walqabatu qabda.

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Gubba cell {cell_num} sirnaa bahee. 0 fi {max_board_num} keessatti turu qabda.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Seeliin {cell_num} amma iyyuu kan qabate dha. seellii duwwaa filadhu.

action.placement: Player {current_player_id} akkamii isaa ('{symbol}') cell {cell_num} keessatti rakkeesee.

outcome.winner: Player {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') walakkaa lama walitti dhufeen waliin walqabatee!
